Absolutely amazing!  I've worked with Firefighter Roofing in the past for a couple of smaller repairs and am so glad I had this relationship with them when the bad hail storm hit in March (2024). Luckily, this time we did not have any immediate leaks to patch, but if you know anything about this particular hail storm, you can imagine how much damage was done not only to roofs in my area but to everything that was exposed.  Our cars were beat up (one was totaled), outdoor furniture demolished, masonry (pool entry and flower bed retaining walls) was damaged, fencing and any wooden trim was damaged, gutters were damaged, garage doors were damaged and the roof was toast - including our copper accents and our metal roof over an outdoor sitting area.

Phil assessed the damage and was also on site again when our insurance adjuster was finally able to schedule us - on a Saturday.  Phil quickly took charge with the project management of all of the repairs needed, not just the roofing replacement.  He had amazing contractors he worked with for fence repair and stain, pressure washing damaged furniture and wood trim, copper replacement, gutter replacement and garage door replacement.  I would have been lost as to who to connect with for those projects but Phil took care of all of that for us.

As with any large project, there were some scheduling glitches and plan changes along the way.  This was a 9 month project, after all.  Some things we asked for updates and changes and they were very amenable to what I requested.  Overall, I can confidently say that I would not have wanted to go through this without Firefighter Roofing and specifically without Phil.  His team took care of all insurance supplements as needed and stayed in close contact with my insurance company through every step of the project.  Oftentimes, the hardest step of the project is obtaining approval for the necessary items through the insurance company.  There were several times Firefighter Roofing supplied additional information as needed by the insurance company as well as approached the insurance company with reasons why additional, unforeseen items would need approval.

Basically, with this storm, almost everything on the exterior of our home needed attention and most of it needed full replacement.  We are thrilled with the work ethic of all of the contractors Firefighter secured for us and with the Firefighter team.  They protected our windows, shrubs and pool during the roofing project, they were always on time and very professional.  Phil is especially responsive, even during such a busy time for him and his crew as they had so many projects at once from the storm.

I'm happy to recommend them to anyone needing roofing services, replacement or repair as well as anyone needing project management due to storm damage.  Phil goes above and beyond, even replacing an outdoor light for me that wasn't on the schedule.  He really cares about his customers and gained my trust - I can't say that about many companies or representatives these days.  Don't hesitate to reach out to them!
